# t2 — Migration Risks

## Risk Register

| # | Risk | Severity | Module | Mitigation |
|---|------|----------|--------|------------|
| R1 | **Password hashing algorithm mismatch** — If PasswordHasher is not replicated exactly (SHA-256 + salt, 1000 iterations), all existing user accounts become unusable | CRITICAL | Auth | Copy PasswordHasher.java verbatim. Verify by hashing test user's known password ("password123") against stored hash in data.sql. |
| R2 | **CSRF token field name** — Test script's `extract_csrf` looks for `name="_csrfToken"`. Spring Security defaults to `_csrf`. If mismatched, every POST test fails. | CRITICAL | Security | Configure `HttpSessionCsrfTokenRepository.setParameterName("_csrfToken")`. Verify hidden input in rendered HTML contains `name="_csrfToken"`. |
| R3 | **Spring Security login flow conflict** — Spring Security's default formLogin intercepts POST /login before the controller. If both are active, the manual AuthService.authenticate call in AuthController is bypassed. | HIGH | Security | Disable Spring Security formLogin (`formLogin(f -> f.disable())`). Use AuthController for manual authentication. Set SecurityContext programmatically after successful AuthService call. |
| R4 | **JSP embedded Tomcat packaging** — Spring Boot executable JAR cannot serve JSPs from a standard JAR. Requires `tomcat-embed-jasper` at compile scope, and JSPs must be under `src/main/webapp/`. If misconfigured, all views return 404. | HIGH | Build | Set `tomcat-embed-jasper` to compile scope (not provided). Keep JSPs under `src/main/webapp/WEB-INF/jsp/`. Use `spring.mvc.view.prefix=/WEB-INF/jsp/` and `.suffix=.jsp`. Test JSP rendering early. |
| R5 | **H2 PostgreSQL compatibility** — SQL schema uses PostgreSQL-specific features (ILIKE, VARCHAR, TIMESTAMP). H2's PostgreSQL mode may not support all syntax. | HIGH | DB | Use `MODE=PostgreSQL` in H2 URL. Test schema.sql + data.sql load in H2. Replace any incompatible SQL (e.g., `ILIKE` → H2's `ILIKE` support in PG mode, or add H2-specific schema if needed). |
| R6 | **Tiles removal — layout breakage** — Replacing Tiles with `<jsp:include>` changes how body content is injected. If includes are wrong, pages render without headers/footers or with broken layout. | MEDIUM | View | Each page JSP directly includes header/messages/footer via `<jsp:include>`. Verify every page renders with correct layout by visual comparison with screenshots. |
| R7 | **Struts tag → JSTL/EL conversion errors** — 32 JSPs use `<bean:write filter="true">`, `<logic:iterate>`, `<html:form>` etc. Each must be correctly converted. Missing a tag or wrong EL expression causes blank output or JSP compilation errors. | MEDIUM | View | Systematic tag-by-tag conversion using the mapping table in source-analysis.md. Compile-test each JSP after conversion. |
| R8 | **OrderFacade compensating actions** — The source's 18-step placeOrder has no DB transaction. Porting this without adding `@Transactional` preserves the source's behavior (which is the requirement), but could cause data inconsistency. Adding `@Transactional` changes behavior. | MEDIUM | Order | Replicate the source's exact compensation pattern (void payment, release inventory, refund points on failure). Do NOT add `@Transactional` to placeOrder — match source behavior per constitution Principle I. |
| R9 | **Session fixation handling** — Source LoginAction invalidates old session before creating new one. Spring Security can do this automatically if configured, but if both manual + auto session fixation protection run, the session may be invalidated twice. | MEDIUM | Auth | Use manual session handling in AuthController (matching source). Configure Spring Security `sessionManagement()` to not add its own fixation protection: `.sessionFixation(s -> s.none())`. |
| R10 | **Cart cookie (CART_ID)** — Source sets CART_ID cookie manually via `Set-Cookie` header with HttpOnly + Secure flags. Spring doesn't auto-manage this. | LOW | Cart | Replicate the manual cookie-setting code in CartController. Match attributes: `Max-Age=2592000` (30 days), `Path=/`, `HttpOnly`, `Secure` (if HTTPS). |
| R11 | **Admin URL path mismatch** — Source uses `/admin/product/edit.do`, `/admin/product/delete.do`. Test script uses `/admin/products`, `/admin/orders`, `/admin/coupons`, `/admin/shipping` without `.do`. Confirm test script paths match. | LOW | Admin | Follow test script URLs exactly: `/admin/products`, `/admin/orders`, `/admin/coupons`, `/admin/shipping`. Admin edit/delete paths are internal (form action targets) and not directly tested. |
| R12 | **Inventory FOR UPDATE locking in H2** — H2's `SELECT ... FOR UPDATE` behavior differs from PostgreSQL. In PostgreSQL mode, it should work, but edge cases (concurrent test threads) may differ. | LOW | Inventory | Test inventory reservation with concurrent requests in integration tests. H2's PostgreSQL mode supports `FOR UPDATE`. |
| R13 | **Message properties encoding** — Source uses `messages.properties` for Japanese labels. If Spring's MessageSource doesn't read UTF-8 correctly, labels appear garbled. | LOW | i18n | Set `spring.messages.encoding=UTF-8` in application.properties. |
| R14 | **Point expiration triggered on every balance check** — Source calls `expirePoints()` inside `getAccount()`. This works in the source but could cause performance issues with JdbcTemplate if the transaction scope is different. | LOW | Points | Port the `expirePoints()` logic with `@Transactional` (matches source's manual transaction). Verify in tests. |

## Summary

- **CRITICAL (2)**: Password hashing algorithm, CSRF token field name — both cause total test failure if wrong
- **HIGH (3)**: Spring Security login flow, JSP packaging, H2 compatibility — each blocks the application from functioning
- **MEDIUM (4)**: Tiles removal, tag conversion, OrderFacade compensation, session fixation — cause specific feature failures
- **LOW (5)**: Cookie handling, admin paths, H2 locking, encoding, point expiration — minor issues with straightforward fixes
